package.name: mocap_pad_bridge
package.description: Turns the pad rigid body from motion capture (mocap_optitrack in the lab, the landingplat plugin in M2M_MODE=3) into the catamaran sensor topics the guidance stack reads (/ulisse/nav_filter/data, /adnav_node/imu_raw). The drone pose goes to PX4 through mocap_px4_bridge.
